# Intelligence Briefings

> AI-written summaries of key interviews, keynotes and hearings with leaders in tech, AI, finance and policy, published daily. Every summary links its source YouTube video.

Archive: 2,234 briefings over 251 days, 2024-09-05 to 2026-10-20, updated daily. 1,712 people and 1,113 organizations are indexed.

Summaries are generated by an LLM from the video transcripts and can contain errors: cite and check the source video for anything that matters. The API, feed and markdown files carry summaries only, not transcripts.

## For agents

- [API index](https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/index.json): endpoints, the slug rule, counts, the date list. Start here.
- Person: `https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/people/{slug}.json`: every briefing where they speak, their roles, and `mentioned_in` (briefings that only name them). `https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/people/{slug}.md` has the 10 most recent full summaries in one file.
- Organization: `https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/orgs/{slug}.json` and `.md`: the same, for everyone who speaks for it (units count for their parent).
- Slugs: slug = the name lowercased, with every space, accent and punctuation mark removed: Kevin Warsh -> kevinwarsh, SemiAnalysis -> semianalysis, J.D. Vance -> jdvance, AT&T -> att. Names that are not plain ASCII get a hash suffix; look those up in api/people.json or api/orgs.json.
- Lookups: [people](https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/people.json) and [organizations](https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/orgs.json) map every name to its slug, with briefing and mention counts.
- Day: `https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/days/{YYYYMMDD}.json`: that day's briefings with full markdown summaries.
- Summary: `https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/md/{video_id}.md`: one summary as markdown.
- [Catalog](https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/api/catalog.json): every briefing in one ~2 MB file (title, channel, dates, speakers, organizations, TL;DR, links), newest first. Download and filter it for topic searches.
- [JSON Feed](https://ystephkkkk.github.io/follower-tool-site/feed.json): the latest 50 briefings with full summaries.

People and organizations are indexed from who SPEAKS in each video (name and role as tagged by an LLM; the organization is the employer in that role, sometimes a former one). A unit also counts for its parent ("AWS Worldwide Public Sector" for AWS, "Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis" for Federal Reserve). Briefings that only NAME a person or organization in the title or summary are listed separately, under "mentioned_in".

Tip for a limited fetch budget: for a person or company, fetch its `.md` bundle first (one fetch), then its `.json` for the full list and the mentions.
